title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering (regional failover)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: during last week's regional failover incident we observed the SLO enforcer entering a backoff ordering race that caused repeated circuit-breaker tripping and regional thrashing. Root cause: backoff entries with identical priorities could be reordered by map iteration and timers were being reset without respect to insertion ordering, which allowed newer backoff entries to preempt older ones and caused premature failovers. This hotfix enforces deterministic ordering in the backoff queue, adds hysteresis/jitter to backoff timer resets, and hardens the state transitions between CB states to prevent flip-flop under high contention. Changes include: deterministic priority queue for backoff entries, compare-and-swap guards around state transitions, increased minimum backoff floor, telemetry for ordering and reset events, additional unit and integration tests, and a controlled canary rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce locally with test harness - [x] Add deterministic backoff queue implementation - [x] Add locking around state transitions - [x] Add jitter + hysteresis for timer resets - [x] Add unit + integration tests that reproduce previous thrash - [x] Update SLO enforcer dashboard/alerts - [x] Canary rollout in us-west-2 then global - [x] Post-merge monitoring runbook updated Testing: ran full unit suite, integration tests against local slo-emulator, and a staged canary in us-west-2 for 2 hours with no thrash. Related: ENG-5462 details incident timeline and experiment notes.

release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering to prevent regional failover thrashing. Includes deterministic backoff queue, jitter/hysteresis on resets, CAS guards for CB state transitions, telemetry, and tests. Recommended: monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_reorder_events and slo_enforcer.backoff_reset_count after deployment.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: apply hotfix canary in us-west-2 (5% traffic) for 2 hours and validate no CB thrash. Stage 2: expand to 25% in us-east-1 for 1 hour. Stage 3: global rollout if metrics stable. Feature flag slo_enforcer_backoff_ordering_enabled=false available to rollback quickly.
postmerge_actions: Run targeted alert regression queries, keep canary at 25% for 24h, engage on-call SRE for 48h, and run the incident replay test from ENG-5462 in staging.
notes: This PR is a hotfix; changes are intentionally minimal and avoid surface-area changes to the public API. The deterministic queue uses an atomic insertion counter to preserve ordering across restarts and replicas in the enforcer leader. Added unit tests that simulate high-concurrency inserts and ensure ordering is preserved.
